grounding.states: dark, quiet room and a same-every-time wind-down routine help a child nap
catching sleepy cues before he gets overtired makes napping easier

value.answer: Keep the room dark and quiet, use the same short wind-down every time (a book, a song, a cuddle), and put him down when he first looks sleepy, before he gets overtired, since overtired kids fight sleep harder. How old is he? Nap tips shift a lot by age.
